parsed.summary: The PR adds support for Indexed operations in PythonCodePrinter, but it lacks tests and may introduce regressions.

issues.description: The PR does not include any tests for the new _print_Indexed method, which is crucial for ensuring the functionality works as expected and does not break in future changes.
There is a risk that the new method may introduce regressions or unexpected behavior in other parts of the codebase that rely on PythonCodePrinter.
